model: F-4300 clamp-on ultrasonic flow meter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: ONICON F-4300 clamp-on transit-time ultrasonic flow meters with the RS485 BACnet MS/TP interface.
summary: The F-4300 is a clamp-on transit-time ultrasonic flow meter. Over BACnet MS/TP it reports velocity, flow rate, speed of sound and signal strength, a volume total with previous-day values, two relay states and a sensor status code.
notes: Object names from tables 2a, 3a, 4a and 5a of the PICS section; the device Object_List matches (AI 1-4, AV 1-4, BV 1-3, MSV 1).
Units are not printed per object; the PICS gives them as "Various".
The BV table marks Present_Value writable for all three BVs, including the relay states; only BV 1 is a command.
AI Present_Value is commandable only while Out_Of_Service is true.

source.title: F-4300 Clamp-on Ultrasonic Flow Meter Manual

integration.summary: Read AI 2 for flow rate and AV 1 for the total, and map MSV 1 for sensor faults. AI 4 signal strength helps when the reading looks wrong.
setup: MAC address 1-247 (default 17); device instance default 57017; baud 9600-76800 (default 38400).
Protocol (BACnet or Modbus), device ID and MAC are set in the meter's Special Functions menu.
120 ohm termination by jumper JP1 (default off); no biasing. The manual asks for a 3-wire RS485 connection.
gotchas: Check the Units property of each AI/AV on site; the PICS does not list them.

points.name: Flow Rate
points.description: Volume flow rate at the meter

points.name: Sonic Velocity
points.description: Speed of sound in the liquid

points.name: Previous Day Avg. Flow
points.description: Average flow rate for the previous day

points.name: Previous Day Volume
points.description: Volume total for the previous day

points.name: Reset Volume Total
points.description: Write to reset the volume total

points.name: Flow Sensor Status
points.states: 0=Sensor good, 1=Low signal, 2=Sensor open, 3=Sensor short, 4=Sensor check calibration, 5=Sensor relay fault, 6=Sensor system fault
